inputs.stems: procedural grammar of narrative-cut/mix.py (coin/coin-slot/cloth/washer) + first-minute/audio/bed.py room tone; local only, no providers

plucks.why: gap 4.4-6.1 between cue 1 tail and cue 2
gap 37.11-39.96 after spin clause, before hem reveal
